input.change_text: Security: `Bash(find:*)` allow rules no longer auto-approve `find -exec`/`-delete`

output.subject: Bash(find:*) allow rules no longer auto-approve `find -exec` / `find -delete`
output.action_text: Upgrade to `claude-code` 2.1.113+ to require explicit approval for `find -exec` and `find -delete` even under `Bash(find:*)` allow rules. Pre-fix, `find . -exec rm {} \;` ran without prompting under any `Bash(find:*)` allow — turning `find` into an arbitrary-execution bypass.
